suites.name: Quantization quality preservation
suites.separation_evidence: Run the same protected capability manifests on BF16 and every release quantization; calibration samples come only from recorded training strata.

metrics.name: maximum macro capability loss vs BF16

suites.notes: A good macro cannot compensate for a broken safety, language, tool, or structured-output slice.

suites.name: Serving latency, throughput, memory, and stability
suites.separation_evidence: Target hardware, engines, concurrency, sequence distributions, and SLOs are not yet selected.
suites.language_scope: language-neutral token workload plus representative prompts
suites.notes: Record engine revision, hardware, batch/concurrency, prompt/output lengths, TTFT, inter-token latency, tokens/s, memory, and energy if available.

suites.name: Release artifact and provenance audit
suites.separation_evidence: Two-person review against immutable artifact hashes and signed release checklist.
suites.notes: Require model card, data card references, license/provenance matrix, hashes, eval results, known limits, safety case, moderation guidance, serving recipe, quantizations, incident/canary plan, and signed approval.

suites.name: Independent evaluation reproduction
suites.separation_evidence: A second operator reruns the locked manifest from model and container hashes without private conversational context.
suites.notes: Tolerance must be declared per metric before the rerun.
